Binary search algorithm

Source: R/misc.R
binarysearch.Rd

An R implementation of the binary search of the zero of a continous strictly monotone real function.

Usage

binarysearch(lb, ub, fun, tol = 1e-08)

Arguments

lb

A single numeric value, the lower bound of the interval to seek in the zero point.

ub

A single numeric value, the upper bound of the interval to seek in the zero point.

fun

A continuous monotone real function defined on the interval [lb, ub] such that fun(lb)*fun(ub) < 0.

tol

The precision of the approximation of the zero point to be attained. Default value is 1e-8.

Value

A list with three components :

  • sol, the approximation of the zero point for function fun ;

  • prec, the precision of the approximation, of the form (ub - lb)/2^(iter+1) ;

  • iter, the number of iterations of the binary search while processing the approximation.

Examples

tmpfun <- function(x) return(sqrt(x)-2)
tmpub <- 9
tmplb <- 1
binarysearch(lb = tmplb, ub = tmpub, fun = tmpfun)
#> $sol
#> [1] 4
#> 
#> $prec
#> [1] 7.450581e-09
#> 
#> $iter
#> [1] 29
#>
